purpose: Falsify single-friendly-world native earned-distribution success under same-resource adverse regimes, rather than assuming future demand or releasing a new financial owner.
stopper: Run every registered cohort exactly once; do not retune inputs, select seeds, drop losing arms, or amend thresholds after observing outcomes. Failure of any run remains a failure, not a missing success. Store compact partial failure receipt and preserve logs.

decision_rule.source: Existing design_flywheel developer-observed selection, then independently re-audited heldout veto
decision_rule.robust_for_challenger: All five preregistered cohorts must report positive matched confirmation profit delta, protected obligations, AND an independently audited positive earned-source successor; any no-run/null/failed/adverse arm falsifies across-cohort robustness.
decision_rule.conditional_policy: Per-cohort accepted holdout recommendation only; never combine funds, profits, or obligations between world accounts.
decision_rule.no_deploy: Default absent externally verified buyers and complete full actual resource/billing costs.

outcomes_and_costs: Only canonical engine modeled charges, incurred failures, native reservations, contract tails and audit count as simulated native receipts. Whole experiment compute, model/host costs, unmeasured human comparator, acquisition of real customers, taxes outside modeled policy, refunds and future support beyond model remain unknown, never zero.
objective: US$3,000,000,000 genuine trailing-365 day complete-cost net profit; this finite horizon simulation is not annual proof.
